paragraphs: Sandata sells homecare software and services built around Electronic Visit Verification, which its homepage dates to 1994. The agency management product ties together EVV, scheduling, and billing, with data collection at the point of care. Its Electronic Visit Verification work is framed around Cures Act compliance data elements, member verification, group visits, and service location input.

A separate Revenue Cycle Management service covers authorization review, claim denials, rejection resolution, and resubmissions. The pages name homecare agencies, managed care organizations, and state organizations as the groups these solutions are built for. For state buyers, one line of solutions is described as designed specifically for state Medicaid programs, with oversight and accountability as the stated aim.

The homepage claims over 23 state Medicaid contracts. The same page describes serving homecare providers, payers, and states across what it calls the homecare continuum. The homepage also states that Sandata has been acquired by HHAeXchange.

quote.text: We are the company that invented EVV and have more successful state implementations than anyone in the industry.
